The pull request was merged by `deffenda` on 2026-11-19 at 03:22 UTC, on the head `587fe8e8b9462e174ea01998a18075d6ba0da53b`, with the squash commit `cb2b03be`.

The review of that exact head was not run before the merge. The six reviews that drove the change are recorded in the comment above, each on the head of its round, and every finding of every round was fixed with a regression test that fails without it. The `CI` and `sign-off` checks were green on the merged head.

The count stays an estimate. The README carries the samples and the counts it was measured against, so that the figures can be checked and the rules of the estimate are visible to an operator.
